title: Film brief
description: The human input to the story half. Audience and feeling must be decided by a person before anything is generated.

title.description: The person, place or story the film is about. Used as the research query.

feeling.description: The single feeling or understanding the audience should have at the end.

languages.description: Narration languages as ISO 639 codes. The first is the primary language.

why_it_matters.description: Optional: the director's own reason for choosing this story.
